editorial.name: Blackalgo
editorial.descriptionZh: Blackalgo 是一个用 AI 自动交易 BTC 与 ETH 的策略产品，给 Conservative、Balanced、Dynamic 三种模式，页面上还挂着一个回测计算器。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看深色 HUD 风格怎么包装量化交易产品
editorial.noteZh: 深蓝近黑的底上铺着细网格，顶栏 Engine / Performance / Strategies / Security / Log In / Sign Up，左上角标着 [ 01 / 09 ] 与 HERO 的分节记号。主视觉是一台刻着 Blackalgo AI 的方形装置，左右各立一块写着 BITCOIN 与 ETHEREUM 的石板，标题 The world's best AI to trade BTC & ETH，按钮 Join the Waiting List。往下 [ 02 / 09 ] [ INTRO ] 讲 AI-powered trading algorithms 如何分析趋势、预测机会并自动执行；[ 03 / 09 ] [ AI ] 列 Lightning-fast processing、Institutional-grade security、Real-time, adaptive algorithms，再分 Trade、Manage、Profit 三块；[ 04 / 09 ] [ PERF ] 是个计算器，问 If you'd invested $ 多少 in September 2018 with our Conservative Balanced Dynamic mode today would be $ 3,140，旁边标着 + 968 % 与 REAL-TIME TRACK RECORD SINCE 2018 VERIFIED BY FXBLUE。页脚只有 Disclaimer、Risk Warning、Privacy Policy、Terms of Services。
editorial.pricing: unknown（只有 Join the Waiting List，无价格信息）
